# KOV Career Agency

KOV Career Agency is a founder-led career agency helping senior professionals with private reverse recruiting and executive career representation, and helping companies with global talent sourcing for senior and passive executive roles.

## Services
- Executive career representation and reverse recruiting for senior professionals
- Global executive talent sourcing for companies and hiring teams
- Resume and LinkedIn positioning, outreach, interview support, and offer strategy

## Brand
- Name: KOV Career Agency
- Founder: Daniel Ade
- Website: https://kovcareeragency.org/
- Email: daniel@kovcareeragency.org

## Geographic scope
KOV works across international markets and serves clients in countries worldwide.

## Contact
For service inquiries or a confidential consultation, visit https://kovcareeragency.org/contact.html.
